items.title: yogurt
items.description: Private AI meeting notes that stay on your computer. A free, open-source alternative to Granola for Mac, Windows and Linux.
items.summary: Yogurt is a free, MIT-licensed desktop app that uses on-device AI models to transcribe, summarize, and chat with your meetings. Similar to Granola, Yogurt runs in the background and does not join your calls. But unlike Granola, Yogurt is open-source, free to use, and private. Your meeting transcripts, call recordings, and summaries never leave your computer. It supports Windows, Mac, and Linux, and uses on-device AI models for transcription and summarization. The sources do not provide specific details about the exact platforms or versions supported beyond these general operating systems.

items.title: agentes-chat
items.description: Open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents work together in channels and DMs. Agents run on Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini or Grok, with MCP tools, their own computer and browser, routines, memory and approvals. Web, desktop and phone apps. Docker Compose + Postgres. AGPL-3.0.
items.summary: The sources describe agentes-chat as an open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where teams and AI agents collaborate in channels and direct messages. Agents can run on various AI models including Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini, or Grok, equipped with MCP tools, their own computer and browser, routines, memory, and approvals. It offers web, desktop, and phone apps, and is built with Docker Compose and Postgres, licensed under AGPL-3.0. The GitHub repository for commonly indicates it can be integrated with various AI models and is self-hostable, but does not provide specific details about agentes-chat. The third source discusses Workspace Agents from OpenAI, which are different from agentes-chat.

items.title: ai--manus2.0
items.description: AI Manus is a general-purpose AI Agent system that supports running various tools and operations in a sandbox environment.
items.summary: AI Manus 2.0 is a general-purpose AI Agent system that supports running various tools and operations in a sandbox environment. It can start work based on triggers from connected services like new emails or calendar events. Manus Studio allows it to use only the necessary tools for specific tasks, focusing on the work at hand. The system runs in a sandbox provided by E2B, which uses Firecracker microVMs to create isolated, lightweight virtual computers for Manus. These sandboxes can run for hours and save information for up to 14 days for paid users.

items.title: GitHub-Copilot-app
items.description: The GitHub Copilot app is an agent-native desktop experience for finding, running, steering, and landing software work across your GitHub repositories.
items.summary: The GitHub Copilot app is a desktop application for agent-driven development that provides a single place to manage AI agents across parallel workstreams, GitHub issues, and pull requests, and manage the full development lifecycle without context-switching between terminals, IDEs, and browser tabs. It is built for parallel agent-driven development, with each local session running in its own isolated git worktree, and cloud sessions allowing agents to work in isolated GitHub-hosted environments. The app is available for all Copilot plans and can be downloaded for Windows (x64), Windows (ARM), Mac (Apple Silicon), Mac (Intel), and Linux. Prerequisites include Git and a GitHub Copilot plan, though users can bring their own key (BYOK) with their own model provider if no Copilot plan is available.
